TC-17/S08.title: Meds toggle vs tracker: every status, date and reason in its own row
TC-17/S08.detail: pr-tc17-s08-meds.spec.ts: six tracker rows (active, held 'Held · Oct 12' AKI, changed 'Changed · Oct 10' was 40 mg, stopped 'Stopped · Oct 9', single dose 'Given · Oct 8', active 20 h old) shown identically on the Pre-Round tracker and the Post-Round Meds toggle, row by row; no note/task text, no decoy from another patient or the resident (AC 5, How it works 5). Recorded (Q2): the tracker labels Atorvastatin 'not mentioned today', the Post-Round Meds list does not; the Encounter tab has no tracker on main.
